title: Lee stresses need for Seoul to take lead on peninsular affairs after Trump-Xi-Putin meeting
caption:
Following a rare meeting between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin at APEC, South Korean President Lee Jae Myung cautioned against repeating 1945. Seoul is asserting its authority as the primary stakeholder on peninsular affairs.
